title: Financial-services client onboarding bundle
description: Trust-account and merchant onboarding experiences governed as one client package.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: WorkflowBundle
metadata:
  name: fs-client-onboarding
  title: Financial-services client onboarding bundle
  description: Trust-account and merchant onboarding experiences governed as one client package.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  workflowRef: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-cs-01
  ontology:
    ref: ladder://ontologies/builtin/financial-services
    mode: sliver
    selection:
      propertyRefs: [financial_account.trust_name, merchant_profile.merchant_legal_name, merchant_profile.estimated_monthly_volume, customer_party.contact_name]
      relationshipIds: [holds, onboards]
  forms:
    - { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/fs/trust_account_opening_package, role: start }
    - { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/fs/merchant_onboarding_application, role: start }
